verses.sanskrit: द्रौपद्युवाच । इदं तु ते महद्दुःखं यत् प्रवक्ष्यामि भारत । न मेऽभ्यसूया कर्तव्या दुःखादेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Draupadi said O Bharata, what I am going to tell you now is another great grief of mine; you should not get angry with me, as I tell you this out of a sheer sadness of heart.

verses.sanskrit: सूदकर्मणि हीने त्वमसमे भरतर्षभ । ब्रुवन् बल्लवजातीयः कस्य शोकं न वर्धयेः ॥२॥
verses.english: Who is there whose grief is not enhanced seeing you employed in the abominable service of a cook, entirely unbecoming of you, and calling yourself as belonging to the sect of Ballava.

verses.sanskrit: सुपकारं विराटस्य बल्लवं त्वां विदुर्जनाः । प्रेष्यत्वं समनुप्राप्तं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥३॥
verses.english: What can be more distressful than this that people should know you as Virata's cook Ballava by name and fallen into servitude. When you wait on the king Virata calling yourself as Ballava the cook after getting through the work of the kitchen, then my very niind sinks into despair.

verses.sanskrit: यदा महानसे सिद्धे विराटमुपतिष्ठसि । ब्रुवाणो बल्लवः सूदस्तदा सीदति मे मनः ॥४॥
यदा प्रहृष्टः सम्राट् त्वां संयोधयति कुञ्जरैः । हसन्त्यन्तःपुरे नार्यो मम तूद्विजते मनः ॥५॥
verses.english: When the monarch in joy makes you fight with elephants and the women of his seraglio laugh my mind totally sinks in sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: शार्दूलैर्महिषैः सिंहैरागारे योध्यसे यदा । कैकेय्याः प्रेक्षमाणायास्तदा मे कश्मलं भवेत् ॥६॥
verses.english: When you fought with lions, tigers and buffaloes in the inner apartment of the palace in the occular presence of Kaikayi then the faint came over me.

verses.sanskrit: तत उत्थाय कैकेयी सर्वास्ताः प्रत्यभाषत । प्रेष्याः समुत्थिताश्चापि कैकेयीं ताः स्त्रियोऽब्रुवन् ॥७॥
verses.english: Then rising from her seat along with her maids who also rose up with her, Kaikayi beholding me with limbs uninjured and only overtaken by swoon, addressed them saying "surely it is from the affection originated by living together that this lady of beautiful smile grieves for the cook, seeing him fighting with beasts of exceeding strength. Sairandhri is one of exceeding beauty and Ballava is handsome too, the heart of woman is so hard to know; and me-thinks they both are deserving of each other. Sairandhri is seen constantly lamenting for the connection with her lover and they both have entered this royal family at the same time.” Speaking such words she always scolds me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेक्ष्य मामनवद्याङ्गीं कश्मलोपहातमिव । स्नेहात् संवासजाद्धर्मात् सूदमेषा शुचिस्मिता ॥८॥
योद्ध्यमानं महावीर्यमियं समनुशोचति । कल्याणरूपा सैरन्ध्री बल्लवश्चापि सुन्दरः ॥९॥
स्त्रीणां चित्तं च दुर्ज्ञेयं युक्तरूपौ च मे मतौ । सैरन्ध्री प्रियसंवासान्नित्यं करुणवादिनी ॥१०॥
अस्मिन् राजकुले चेमौ तुल्यकालनिवासिनौ । इति ब्रुवाणा वाक्यानि सा मां नित्यमतर्जयत् ॥११॥
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रियसंवासात् प्रियस्य भीमसेनस्य संवासः सहवासः सम्बन्धः तस्मात् । तस्मिन् हस्त्यादिभिः सह योध्यमाने सति करुणावादिनी दीनवादिनी भवति ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: क्रुध्यन्तीं मां च संप्रेक्ष्य समशङ्कत मां त्वयि । तस्यां तथा ब्रुवत्यां तु दुःखं मां महदाविशत् ॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding me getting enraged she suspects me to be attached to you which she speaks; thus I am overtaken by great grief.

verses.sanskrit: त्वय्येवं निरयं प्राप्ते भीमे भीमपराक्रमे । शोके यौधिष्ठिरे मग्ना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥१३॥
verses.english: Beholding you, O Bhima of terrible prowess, suffering from being fallen into such a dire calamity and sunk in grief for Yudhishthira I do not intend to live.

verses.sanskrit: यः सदेवान् मनुष्यांश्च सर्वांश्चैकरथोऽजयत् । सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कन्यानां नर्तको युवा ॥१४॥
verses.english: Alas! that youthful one, who on a single car defeated all celestials and men, is now the dancing master of the daughters of the king Virata.

verses.sanskrit: योऽतर्पयद‌मेयात्मा खाण्डवे जातवेदसम् । सोन्तःपुरगतः पार्थ कूपेऽग्निरिव संवृतः ॥१५॥
verses.english: That Pritha's son, who with his immeasurable energy gratified the fire-god in the Khandava forest, is now stationed in the seraglio like fire concealed in a well.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्भयममित्राणां सदैव पुरुषर्षभात् । स लोकपरिभूतेन वेषेणास्ते धनञ्जयः ॥१६॥
verses.english: That Dhananjaya, from whom, the best of men, enemies had constant dread, is now living in a guise hated by all.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ज्याक्षेपकाठिनौ बाहू परिघसन्निभौ । स शङ्खपरिपूर्णाभ्यां शोचन्नास्ते धनञ्जयः ॥१७॥
verses.english: That Dhananjaya, whose arms are likes inaces of iron and are marked by the strokes of the bow-string, is living in grief with his wrists covered with conch-bracelets.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषात् समकम्पन्त शत्रवः । स्त्रियो गीतस्वनं तस्य मुदिताः पर्युपासते ॥१८॥
verses.english: The singing sound of that one, the sound of whose bow-string caused tremble to his enemies, is now courted by only delightful women.

verses.sanskrit: किरीटं सूर्यसङ्काशं यस्य मूर्द्धन्यशोभत । वेणीविकृतकेशान्तः सोऽयमद्य धनञ्जयः ॥१९॥
verses.english: That Dhananjaya, whose head was decked with a diadem of solar effulgence, is now appearing with braids ending in ugly curls.

verses.sanskrit: तं वेणीकृतकेशान्तं भीमधन्वानमर्जुनम् । कन्यापरिवृतं दृष्ट्वा भीम सीदति मे मनः ॥२०॥
verses.english: O Bhima, seeing that mighty wielder of bow, Arjuna, with braids ending in ugly curls and surrounded by damsels, my heart is stricken with distress.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्नस्त्राणि दिव्यानि समस्तानि महात्मनि । आधारः सर्वविद्यानां स धारयति कुण्डले ॥२१॥
verses.english: That high-souled one, to whom all the celestials weapons are known, and who is the repository of all the sciences, is now wearing a pair of ear-rings.

verses.sanskrit: स्प्रष्टुं राजसहस्त्राणि तेजसाऽप्रतिमानि वै । समरे नाभ्यवर्तन्त वेलामिव महार्णवः ॥२२॥
verses.english: That youthful one, whom myriads of kings of matchless prowess could not overcome in fight, even as the great ocean cannot overleap its banks, is now the dancing master of the daughters of king Virata and passes his days in disguise as one in the capacity of a servant to them.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽयं राज्ञो विराटस्य कन्यानां नर्तको युवा । आस्ते वेशप्रतिच्छन्नः कन्यानां परिचारकः ॥२३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: स्प्रष्टुमाकलायतुं यमिति शेषः । यस्येत्यपि पठन्ति । अप्रतिमानीति छेदः ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: यस्य स्म रथघोषेण समकम्पत मेदिनी । सपर्वतवना भीम सहस्थावरजङ्गमा ॥२४॥
verses.english: O Bhima, that exalted younger brother of yours, the rattling sound of whose car-wheels made the entire earth with all her mountains and forests and with all things mobile and immobile, tremble, and O Bhimasena, who being born, all the grief's of Kunti vanished, now causes me to lament for him.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन् जाते महाभागे कुन्त्याः शोको व्यनश्यत । स शोचयति मामद्य भीमसेन तवानुजः ॥२५॥
भूषितं तमलङ्कारैः कुण्डलैः परिहाटकैः । कम्बुपाणिनमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा सीदति मे मनः ॥२६॥
verses.english: Beholding him approaching me adorned with golden ear-rings and other ornaments and with wrists with bracelets of conches, my heart sinks into sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य नास्ति समो वीर्ये कश्चिदुर्व्यां धनुर्धरः । सोऽद्य कन्यापरिवृतो गायन्नास्ते धनञ्जयः ॥२७॥
verses.english: That Dhananjaya, to whom there is no bowman on the entire earth, equal in prowess, is now passing his days in singing surrounded by women.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मे शौर्ये च सत्ये च जीवलोकस्य संमतम् । स्त्रीवेषविकृतं पार्थं दृष्ट्वा सीदति मे मनः ॥२८॥
verses.english: Beholding that son of Pritha honored to the world for virtue, prowess and truthfulness, now living in the hated guise of a woman, my heart sinks into sorrow.

verses.sanskrit: यदा होनं परिवृतं कन्याभिर्देवरूपिणम् । प्रभिन्नमिव मातङ्गं परिकीर्णं करेणुभिः ॥२९॥
verses.english: When I look upon that good-like Partha surrounded by females in this music hall like an elephant of rent temples encircled by sheelephant before Virata, the king of the Matsyas, then all the cardinal points seem to me to have lost their existence.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यमर्थपतिं पार्थं विराटं समुपस्थितम् । पश्यामि तुर्यमध्यस्थं दिशो नश्यन्ति मे तदा ॥३०॥
नूनमार्या न जानाति कृच्छ्रं प्राप्तं धनञ्जयम् । अजातशत्रु कौरव्यं मग्नं दुर्द्यूतदेविनम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: Surely my mother-in-law does not know Dhananjaya sorely distressed with sorrow; nor does she know the descendant of Kuru, Ajatashatru, addicted to vicious gambling thus sunk in misery.

verses.sanskrit: तथा दृष्ट्वा यवीयांसं सहदेवं गवां पतिम् । गोषु गोवेषमायान्तं पाण्डुभूताऽस्मि भारत ॥३२॥
verses.english: 0 Bharata, beholding Sahadeva, the youngest of you all, in the capacity of a protector of kine and in the guise of a cowherd, I grow pale.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवस्य वृत्तानि चिन्तयन्ती पुनः पुनः । न निद्रामभिगच्छामि भीमसेन कुतो रतिम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Thinking over and over of Sahadeva's office I cannot obtain sleep what to speak of rest?

verses.sanskrit: न विन्दामि महाबाहो सहदेवस्य दुष्कृतम् । यस्मिन्नेवंविधं दुःखं प्राप्नुयात् सत्यविक्रमः ॥३४॥
verses.english: 0 mighty-armed one, I know not of Sahadeva's sin for which that one of unfailing prowess suffers thus.

verses.sanskrit: दूयामि भरतश्रेष्ठ दृष्ट्वा ते भ्रातरं प्रियम् । गोषु गोवृषसङ्काशं मत्स्येनाभिनिवेशितम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: O foremost of the Bharata's beholding the beloved brother of yours, the foremost of men, appointed by the king of the Matsyas in looking after his kine, I feel grieved.

verses.sanskrit: संरब्धं रक्तनेपथ्यं गोपालानां पुरोगमम् । विराटमभिनन्दन्तमथ मे भवति ज्वरः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Beholding that hero clad in red garments, busy in gratifying Virata and posing himself at the head of the cowherds, fever comes on me.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवं हि मे वीरं नित्यमार्या प्रशंसति । महाभिजनसंपन्नः शीलवान् वृत्तवानिति ॥३७॥
verses.english: My mother-in-law always speaks of that heroic Sahadeva as one possessed of high reputation, good character and excellent conduct.
verses.bhavadeepa: रक्तनेपथ्यं रक्तं गैरिकादिधातुमयं नेपथ्यमलङ्कारो यस्य तम् ॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit: ह्रीनिषेवो मधुरवाक् धार्मिकश्च प्रियश्च मे । स तेऽरण्येषु वोढव्यो याज्ञसेनि क्षपास्वपि ॥३८॥
verses.english: Kunti, greatly attached to her sons, stood weeping with Sahadeva in her arms, while he was starting (with us) for the great forest and addressed me thus-"Sahadeva is bashful, sweet-voiced, virtuous, and very dear to me, therefore, Yajnaseni cheer him up while he feels dejected and tend him in the forest, day and night. He is tender and brave, devoted to the king, heroic and always respectful to his elder brother; O Panchali, feed him yourself."

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारश्च शूरश्च राजानं चाप्यनुव्रतः । ज्येष्ठापचायिनं वीरं स्वयं पाञ्चालि भोजयेः ॥३९॥
इत्युवाच हि मां कुन्ती रुदती पुत्रगृद्धिनी । प्रव्रजन्तं महारण्यं तं परिष्वज्य तिष्ठती ॥४०॥
तं दृष्ट्वा व्यापृतं गोषु वत्सचर्मक्षपाशयम् । सहदेवं युधां श्रेष्ठं किं नु जीवामि पाण्डव ॥४१॥
verses.english: Beholding that Sahadeva, the best of warriors, engaged in tending kine and lying on calf skins at night, O Pandava, how can I live?

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्रिभिर्नित्यसंपन्नो रूपेणास्त्रेण मेधया । सोऽश्वबन्धो विराटस्य पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम् ॥४२॥
verses.english: Again that one, who is gifted with the three attributes of beauty, arms and intellect, is now tending the steed of Virata. Lo! how times change!
verses.bhavadeepa: वत्सचर्मणि क्षपायां शेते इति तं वत्सचर्मक्षपाशयम् ॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यकीर्यन्त वृन्दानि दामग्रन्थिमुदीक्ष्य तम् । विनयन्तं जवेनाश्वान् महाराजस्य पश्यतः ॥४३॥
verses.english: Granthika, at whose presence hostile forces ran away from the field of battle, is now engaged in training horses before the king driving them with speed.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यमेनं श्रीमन्तं मत्स्यं भ्राजिष्णुमुत्तमम् । विराटमुपतिष्ठन्तं दर्शयन्तं च वाजिनः ॥४४॥
verses.english: I now see that graceful one wait upon the richly dressed and excellent Virata, the king of the Matsya's and make a show of his horses before the king.
verses.bhavadeepa: अभ्यकीर्यन्त व्यशीर्यन्त वृन्दानि शत्रूणामिति शेषः । दामग्रन्थिं ग्रन्थिकम् ॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: किं नु मां मन्यसे पार्थ सुखिनीति परन्तप । एवं दुःखशताविष्टा युधिष्ठिरनिमित्ततः ॥४५॥
verses.english: O Pritha's son, afflicted with hundreds of sorrows on account of Yudhishthira, do you deem me happy, O repressor of foes.
verses.bhavadeepa: एनं नकुलं वाजिनोऽश्वान् दर्शयन्तं विराटं विराटाय ॥४४॥

verses.sanskrit: अतः प्रतिविशिष्टानि दुःखान्यन्यानि भारत । वर्तन्ते मयि कौन्तेय वक्ष्यामि शृणु तान्यपि ॥४६॥
verses.english: O Bharata, there are various other woes greater than these which I am afflicted with; listen, O son of Kunti, I shall relate tell them all to you.

verses.sanskrit: युष्मासु ध्रियमाणेषु दुःखानि विविधान्युत । शोषयन्ति शरीरं मे किं नु दुःखमतः परम् ॥४७॥
verses.english: Alas, you being all alive these various woes (render my person emaciated) undermine my system; what can be sadder than this?
